known_differences.statement: Source /members/<slug> and /profile/<slug> pages belong to real third-party users and their slugs derive from personal email addresses. They are not captured. The clone implements the community and gallery surfaces in full, seeded with generated fictional users.
known_differences.reason: Private personal data must never be persisted (AGENTS.md / source-evidence-access-policy.md). No supplied trace requires a stranger's profile page.

known_differences.statement: Source /rss/*.rss feeds are not captured as pages.
known_differences.reason: Feeds are syndication artifacts, not routes in the declared scope.

known_differences.statement: /facebook/signin and equivalent identity-provider hand-offs leave the source origin and are not captured. The clone renders the provider buttons and routes them to a declared boundary.
known_differences.reason: Out of configured origin scope.

known_differences.statement: Class video streams, manifests and subtitle tracks are not downloaded. The player is a layout-equivalent placeholder; poster frames and thumbnails are reproduced.
known_differences.reason: User ruling 2026-08-28 (口径 7).

known_differences.statement: Each subcategory list renders every source card. Only the first 12 classes per subcategory were captured, so cards beyond that link to a DIFFERENT reproduced class detail page instead of the source's own target: the substitute prefers a related pool when one is available (the page's own subcategory, then its category, then a slug match) and otherwise falls back to the site-wide pool; it is keyed by CRC32 of the original path so every build resolves identically. It does NOT guarantee the destination is topically related to the link text: measured across 60 subcategory pages, 24% land in the same subcategory, 32% in the same category, 43% in a different category. Consequence: the link text names class X while the destination is reproduced class Y. Measured: 0 boundary links and 0 dead links across subcategory lists (40-page sample, 1853 links). 457 unique class detail pages reproduced out of 1359 discovered.
known_differences.reason: User rulings 2026-08-28 (口径 9, N=12) and 2026-08-29 (「除非你能再补齐有卡片但是显示 404 的页面，不然就采用我这个」: keep the substitution rather than sending truncated cards to a dead-end boundary page). User ruling 2026-08-30: the goal is that every card leads somewhere real, not that it leads somewhere topically similar — the source's own recommendations are not same-category either.

known_differences.statement: The source returns HTTP 200 with a branded not-found body for unknown routes. The clone returns a real 404 with the same branded body so the not-found checkpoint stays distinguishable from the truncation boundary page.
known_differences.reason: Trace checkpoint requires a distinguishable not-found.

known_differences.statement: Source analytics and tracking pixels are removed at build time to satisfy runtime_remote_requests: forbidden.
known_differences.reason: Offline closure invariant.

known_differences.statement: Source /transcript/pdf/<id> endpoints serve class transcript PDFs (153 discovered). They are not downloaded; links resolve to the out-of-scope boundary page.
known_differences.reason: Transcripts are the paid instructional content in text form; excluding them follows the same ruling as video (口径 7). They are also file downloads, not routes.

known_differences.statement: 321 pattern detail pages were discovered; 38 are reproduced. The patterns index renders every source card and all of its pattern links resolve to reproduced pages (measured: 11 unique links, 0 boundary, 0 dead).
known_differences.reason: User ruling 2026-08-28 (截断).

known_differences.statement: The source /blog path returns HTTP 403; the captured artifact is an error page, not content. It is not reproduced as a page and links route to the out-of-scope boundary.
known_differences.reason: Source-side restriction, not a clone gap.

known_differences.statement: 9 source hrefs contain unencoded spaces (collection names). The pages are captured and shipped, and the builder percent-encodes the hrefs. Until 2026-08-30 three of them still answered 404: ROUTES keys come from directory names and contain real spaces, while the server looked up the raw urlparse path, which keeps '%20'. The server now unquotes the path before lookup, and all of these routes answer 200.
known_differences.reason: Defect in the source markup. Correcting the encoding preserves real pages rather than discarding them.

known_differences.statement: Five files are served from clone/static/assets/ but are not declared in source-assets/manifest.json: cbugfavicon.ico plus four legacy SVG *font* files (glyphicons-halflings-regular.svg, icomoon-cb.svg, video2.svg, cooper-hewitt-light.svg). gen_manifest.py declares pixel dimensions for every asset and drops entries whose dimensions cannot be determined; an .ico and SVG font files have no meaningful raster dimensions. The clone must still serve them because the source CSS references them in @font-face src lists. Counts: manifest 11803 declared, 11808 files on disk, difference exactly these 5, and zero declared-but-missing files.
known_differences.reason: Dimension extraction is not applicable to .ico and SVG fonts. Declaring them without dimensions would break the asset-closure check that compares declared vs observed bytes and dimensions.

known_differences.statement: Some source forms carry no action attribute and submit via source JavaScript, which is removed at build time. The clone assigns those forms an explicit endpoint per route (/trial/create-account and /subscribe/create-account both target /api/auth/register/start), and normalises Rails-style member[...] field names to the clone's API keys.
known_differences.reason: FAST-CLONE §4.5 behavioural equivalence: the source DOM is preserved and the action is supplied by the clone, rather than replacing the page with a generic authored login card (AUTH-FLOW step 5).

known_differences.statement: Every class is seeded with unit_count = 1. The source loads its chapter list over AJAX and the static DOM carries no per-chapter data, so no real unit breakdown could be captured. The progress state machine supports N units; only the seed value is degenerate.
known_differences.reason: Source chapter data is not present in any captured artifact; inventing units would be fabrication.

known_differences.statement: Search supports level, topic/category, subcategory, instructor, duration range and minimum rating. The language and schedule filters named in the task traces have no corresponding facet in any captured source page.
known_differences.reason: No source evidence for those facets; declaring them would be an unsupported claim.

known_differences.statement: Quiz grading is clone-authored and deterministic (server-side, seeded from the class id). The source exposes no quiz payload in captured artifacts.
known_differences.reason: Trace 12 requires a quiz with feedback; no source answer key exists to reproduce.

known_differences.statement: A small number of image URLs referenced by source pages do not exist on the source; it answers them with HTTP 200 and its branded not-found HTML rather than 404. Those responses are not shipped as assets and are not declared in the manifest, so the corresponding images are absent in the clone.
known_differences.reason: Same soft-404 behaviour recorded in source_soft_404_returns_200. Shipping an HTML body under a .jpg name would be a broken image plus a false asset declaration; inspect_asset (§7.1 step 1) rejects it by design.

known_differences.statement: The source home page injects a hero video with JavaScript over a dark CSS background image. Clone JS is removed and video is not reproduced, so the clone renders the source's own dark background directly. Reference frames captured a light video frame, so home.loaded.desktop measures 0.6366 against them.
known_differences.reason: Direct consequence of 口径 7 (video not reproduced) plus FAST-CLONE §4.5 script removal. Deleting the background to raise the score would make the clone diverge from the source CSS in order to imitate content we deliberately do not reproduce.

known_differences.statement: Reference frames are single point-in-time captures of a site whose home page, community feed and dashboards change between visits. Similarity against them measures both clone fidelity and source volatility; the two cannot be separated from the score alone.
known_differences.reason: Recorded so a low score is not read as clone defect without checking the band diagnosis.

known_differences.statement: Mobile viewports (414x896) are out of scope. Five mobile checkpoints were removed from the frozen contract on 2026-08-29: home.loaded.mobile, subcategory-list.loaded.mobile, class-detail.loaded.mobile, signup-entry.loaded.mobile, dashboard.loaded.mobile. The visual checkpoint set went from 26 to 21, all desktop (1440x900). The five captured mobile reference frames are retired, not deleted: scope/retired-mobile-evidence/. Three horizontal-overflow findings that only occurred at 414px width fall out of scope with them (home 422/414, signup-entry 416/414, subcategory-list 422/414). The clone still serves the same responsive markup as the source; only the verification surface narrowed.
known_differences.reason: User ruling 2026-08-29:「我们不做移动端」. This is a scope reduction, not a fix: removing the five checkpoints changed no pass/fail outcome — all five were already below the 0.94 threshold and none of the 10 passing checkpoints were mobile. Pass count stays 10; the denominator drops from 26 to 21.

known_differences.statement: Source tab / collapse / dropdown controls are driven by bootstrap.js, which is removed with all source scripts (§4.5). The clone reimplements the three behaviours in clone-runtime.js against the shipped CSS contract (.collapse.in, .tab-content>.active, .open>.dropdown-menu). Popovers are not reimplemented; their data-content is copied into the native title attribute so the text is still reachable.
known_differences.reason: These controls carry no inline onclick, so removing bootstrap.js made them silently inert rather than erroring. Measured before the fix: 1,603 tab controls on 531 class pages left Chapters / Materials / Gallery / Annotations / Transcript unreachable, plus 19,186 collapse and 1,813 dropdown controls. Behaviour is reimplemented, not the library.

known_differences.statement: Class notes (newAnnotation), comment like / reply / edit, and the notification Clear All are reimplemented in clone-runtime.js as client-side behaviour. The clone exposes no server endpoint for them, so their effects do not survive a request. Clear All is kept across the source's own location.reload() via sessionStorage.
known_differences.reason: The source persists these server-side. Capturing another user's notes or comments is out of scope under the source-evidence access policy, and inventing a backend would fabricate state the source did not provide. Leaving the buttons inert was the worse option: they are visible, enabled controls.

known_differences.statement: External resource references that cannot be shipped are neutralised to a 1x1 transparent GIF data: URI rather than about:blank.
known_differences.reason: about:blank is not an image URL: the browser still starts a load and fails with ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME. Measured before the change: 3,662 such references over 1,007 pages, 2-3 console errors on every page, and 767 visible rendering as broken icons (708 of them the Login with Amazon button). A data: URI is fetch-free and renders as nothing.
